root_causes.before: AuthProvider only transitioned to unauthenticated on 401. Timeouts, network failures, and non-401 API failures left status as checking.
root_causes.after: AuthProvider calls clearSession for any session-check failure that belongs to the active generation.

root_causes.before: PublicOnly returned null while redirecting authenticated users, which could blank the page if navigation stalled.
root_causes.after: PublicOnly keeps rendering children and performs redirect asynchronously.

root_causes.before: Root page performed server redirect to /dashboard.
root_causes.after: Root page returns HTTP 200 login fallback; authenticated users are still routed to /dashboard by PublicOnly after mount.

root_causes.before: .next/static existed but .next/standalone/.next/static could be missing outside the Docker COPY path.
root_causes.after: Build script prepares standalone runtime assets after every next build.

tests_added_or_updated: auth initialization failures do not leave session status checking forever
login route renders independently from public-only auth readiness
root entry renders initial HTML while preserving dashboard redirect after auth
